answers.core: Because this _enables_ addons to be made without having to do multiple pull requests or segregate a useful new  `EditorExportPlatform` to a quickly out-of-date custom branch. It also improves what seems to already be the intent of `EditorExportPlatformExtention` already, by allowing for existing platforms to also be extended without having to reproduce every step manually.
answers.workaround: To work around this, you must recompile the whole engine, as this can only otherwise be done as a module.

title: Allow for general extension of any EditorExportPlatform instead of having a EditorExportPlatformExtention type
